record.destination: A human can scan every map decision in one deterministic, read-only store-wide ledger, filter it by time, actor, provenance, or map, and zoom from each row to the canonical ticket, map, and cited source records.
fog: Large-store ergonomics beyond the first measured read-cost and default-window decision.
Whether a future ledger should span multiple Nahel stores or projects.
How renamed roadmap nodes and maps should render historically while stable ids remain canonical.
out_of_scope: Editing, resolving, ratifying, or otherwise mutating decisions from the ledger; this surface is read-only.
Non-map decisions such as ADR approvals, PRD approvals, merges, and deployment events; this delta is the across-maps ledger.
LLM-generated summaries, semantic clustering, or inferred provenance inside the deterministic CLI.
External tracker mirrors, web UI, and cross-project aggregation.
Duplicating full rationale or source bodies in each row; users zoom to canonical records.

payload.body: Initial intent fixes the row core: decision one-liner, ticket and map, deciding actor, provenance, filters exemplified by --since 7d and --by agent, and zoom through ticket show or recall. Planning-partner 0.4.0 is the released predecessor; its archived PRD stays closed. The CLI remains deterministic and read-only, canonical truth stays in tickets, journal events, and observations, and the recall quoted-phrase hint is only a fold-in candidate.
